basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old student based in Bangalore, pursuing a degree in Information Technology. I've recently gotten into gaming, with a particular interest in medieval RPGs like Kingdom Come: Deliverance. I'm also into reading manga during my downtime and trying to pick up ethical hacking skills. I'm usually online late at night after classes, and I'm single. I dislike overly strict environments but enjoy engaging in casual discussions with fellow gamers and tech enthusiasts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational understanding of IT and programming from my university courses. Recently, I've been self-teaching ethical hacking through online resources and forums. My interest in medieval history and gaming is mostly self-taught, fueled by playing RPGs and reading related content online.
